title: BAN-PLAYERS-1 build A (lasting ban): an in-lobby DEV ban of a connected client (tag bannedgame, approved text) is saved; its rejoin is refused with tag banned (approved text) in the lobby, after a re-host, and after a host process restart; unban -> joins; in game the merged member is banned (clean leave - no paused-until-rejoin, avatar removed, buildings held, absence stand-in starts); unban -> rejoins. The rig's 127.0.0.1 is never recorded as an address (refusals match by stable id). BUILD C1 legs: (F1) an address refreshed by a refused retry keeps matching after first-recorded + 7 days; (F2) a 'steam-N' stable-id ban refuses a joiner vouched as N and learns the Steam id; (F5) in-game ban = one leave cleanup, nothing processed after; (G1) a ban added while a join request waits refuses it at approval, and BanPlayer reaches a waiting request; (D67) the banned client goes back to the menu with no disconnect save.
preconditions: Dev build with the 'ban'/'unban' levers. Fixture save1 (host melaus, client Client1). Uses the driver's drop/relaunch steps for the host. The host's saved ban list is emptied at the start and must be empty at the end (the last 'ban list'); fixture_reset re-prepares the save the disconnect save touches. Steam joins cannot be exercised on the one-account rig. Build C1: the DEV levers 'ban devaddr|devsteam|devpark' stand in for a public joiner address, a Steam-vouched id and a parked returning joiner (fixed values, never printed).
oracles_absent: banned link \d+: a second disconnect report
